tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Full-text search over the Free3D.io catalog (name, description, tags). Returns model ids — follow up with get_model_card for metadata or download_model (paid).

tools.name: get_model_card
tools.description: Public metadata card for one model: title, category, tags, formats, preview, canonical URL, license note. Same payload as GET /x402/card/{hash}.json.

tools.name: download_model
tools.description: x402-gated download access, $0.10. Call without `payment` to get the offer (accepts: Base USDC via EIP-3009 gasless, or legacy on-chain USDC/USDT/PYUSD on Solana/Tron/EVM). Then retry with payment.payload (base64 PaymentPayload) or payment.tx_hash + payment.network. Returns access_token + download U

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "download_model" references sensitive artifacts (access_token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
